title: PARAMO Ecuador Results Explorer: Planning And Resource Allocation under Multi-scenario Optimization
description: Interactive public explorer for long-term Ecuador power-system planning results generated with PARAMO. Version 2.4.0 refreshes the Ecuador 6-bus layer with the final four-scenario run completed on 30 August 2026 while retaining georeferenced transmission, corridor decisions, hydropower cascades, explicit figure units and controlled research-data access.
